prompt: Ultra-realistic photographic portrait of Kaido from \"One Piece\" transformed into a majestic and terrifying Azure Dragon (青龍), realistically enormous and intimidating, spanning across a stormy night sky. Massive serpentine body covered in vividly realistic scales of deep azure and teal hues, gleaming wet with rain, reflecting lightning flashes. Hyper-detailed texture on scales, each intricately defined and realistically imperfect, showing battle scars and subtle imperfections. Dragon’s head fierce and imposing, golden eyes glowing intensely with natural reflections, expressing fury and dominance. Realistic horns extending sharply from the head, dark and weathered, spiraling with natural ridges and texture. Flowing, wild mane of thick black hair with realistic grey highlights, whipping chaotically in the stormy wind. Surrounded by a dramatic dark fantasy atmosphere inspired by \"Greed Island,\" storm clouds swirling violently, lightning striking vividly, illuminating ancient ruins, mystical forests, and glowing runes beneath. Powerful cinematic lighting emphasizing the dragon’s formidable presence, dramatic shadows, vivid contrasts, and atmospheric depth. Highly detailed environmental effects including mist, rain droplets, lightning arcs, and realistically swirling dust particles. DSLR photography quality, ultra-detailed textures, highly photorealistic, cinematic realism, hyper-detailed skin and scale textures, vivid visual fidelity, subtle imperfections ensuring photographic authenticity, dynamic motion blur effects highlighting powerful movement. 16K resolution. --ar 9:16 --raw --v 7
